newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo, Zeneca off as NatWest cuts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo, Zeneca off as NatWest cuts forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc and Zeneca Plc lost their early advance on Wednesday as analysts at NatWest Securities cut earnings estimates for the two drug groups due to the strength of sterling, dealers said.
For 1997 NatWest cut its forecast for pre-tax profit at Glaxo to 2.870 billion stg from 3.196 billion while for Zeneca it cut to 1.080 billion stg from 1.221 billion, market sources said.
Sources said NatWest had also trimmed its 1997 estimate for pre-tax profit at SmithKline Beecham Plc to 1.666 billion stg from 1.850 billion.
The brokerage also cut Glaxo to a "hold" from a "buy" and has a "neutral" rating on the sector as a whole, dealers said.
Shares in Glaxo were down 12p at 901 by 0911 GMT in active volume of 2.1 million shares. Zeneca was down 15p at 16.28-1/2 stg while SmithKline was down 1/2p at 784.
Analysts at NatWest were not immediately available for comment.
